meta.title: Algebra
meta.subtitle: Notation, indices, expanding and factorising, formulae, graphs, simultaneous and quadratic equations, inequalities, and sequences.

meta.title: Geometry
meta.subtitle: Angle facts, shapes, congruence and similarity, transformations, Pythagoras, circle theorems, trigonometry, and vectors.

meta.title: Number
meta.subtitle: Ordering, arithmetic, primes, indices, and working exactly with fractions, surds, and bounds.

meta.title: Probability
meta.subtitle: Relative frequency, sample spaces, exhaustive and mutually exclusive events, Venn/tree diagrams, and conditional probability.

meta.title: Ratio and Proportion
meta.subtitle: Scale factors, ratio notation, percentages, direct/inverse proportion, similarity, and growth and decay.

meta.title: Statistics
meta.subtitle: Tables, charts and diagrams for categorical, discrete and continuous data, averages and spread, and scatter graphs.

meta.title: Units
meta.subtitle: Standard and compound units, and converting cleanly between them for speed, density, pressure, and cost problems.

meta.title: Algebra and Functions
meta.subtitle: Indices, surds, quadratics and the discriminant, simultaneous equations, inequalities, polynomial division, the factor and remainder theorems, and functions.

meta.title: Coordinate Geometry
meta.subtitle: Equations of straight lines, parallel and perpendicular conditions, the equation of a circle, and the circle theorems.

meta.title: Differentiation
meta.subtitle: The derivative as a gradient and rate of change, differentiating powers of x, tangents and normals, stationary points, and increasing/decreasing functions.

meta.title: Exponentials and Logarithms
meta.subtitle: The graph of y = a^x, the laws of logarithms, and solving exponential equations.

meta.title: Graphs of Functions
meta.subtitle: Sketching common functions, modulus graphs, transformations of y = f(x), and composite functions f(g(x)).

meta.title: Integration
meta.subtitle: Integrating powers of x, definite integrals and area, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, combining integrals, the trapezium rule, and solving dy/dx = f(x).

meta.title: Sequences and Series
meta.subtitle: Recurrence relations, arithmetic and geometric series, sum to infinity, and the binomial expansion with nCr.

meta.title: Trigonometry
meta.subtitle: Sine and cosine rules, triangle area, radians, arc length and sector area, standard angles, graphs, identities, and solving trig equations.

meta.title: Electricity
meta.subtitle: Charging by friction and induction, circuit symbols, current, voltage, resistance, V–I graphs, and series/parallel rules.

meta.title: Magnetism
meta.subtitle: Poles and field patterns, soft and hard magnetic materials, the field around currents and coils, the motor effect and F = BIL, dc motors, electromagnetic induction, ac generators, and transformers.

meta.title: Matter
meta.subtitle: States of matter and the particle model, ideal gases and PV = constant, melting/boiling and latent heat, density, and pressure including hydrostatic pressure.

meta.title: Mechanics
meta.subtitle: Scalars and vectors, motion graphs, forces, Hooke's law, Newton's laws, mass and weight, momentum, and work/energy/power.

meta.title: Radioactivity
meta.subtitle: Atomic structure, nuclide notation and isotopes, alpha/beta/gamma decay and nuclear equations, penetration, ionisation, background radiation, applications, and half-life.

meta.title: Thermal Physics
meta.subtitle: Conduction, convection, thermal (infrared) radiation, and specific heat capacity.

meta.title: Waves
meta.subtitle: Wave properties and the wave equation, reflection/refraction/the Doppler effect, ray diagrams, sound and ultrasound, and the electromagnetic spectrum.
